blocks.title: Backtracking
blocks.text: Backtracking hal qadam ba qadam banata hai; agar koi raasta hal tak na le jaye to wapas ja kar doosra raasta aazmata hai, jaise naqshe par ghalat raste par hon to wapas mur jana.
Yeh un masail ke liye istemal hota hai jin mein tamam imkanaat dekhne hon, jaise puzzles aur mel.

blocks.prompt: N-Queens masle ke hawale se backtracking samjhaiye (long question 5).
blocks.explanation: N x N board par N queens aise rakhein ke koi do ek qataar, sutoon ya tirchi line mein na hon. Har qataar mein ek queen, pehli qataar se shuru; har qataar mein baen se daen sutoon aazmayein aur pehla mehfooz rakhein, phir agli qataar par jayein. Agar kisi qataar mein koi mehfooz sutoon na ho to pichhli qataar par wapas ja kar us queen ko agle mehfooz sutoon par le jayein aur jari rakhein. Tamam N qataarein bhar jayein to hal mil gaya; is tarah har imkan aazmane se tamam hal milte hain. N = 4 ke 2 hal hain, maslan qataar 1 se 4 mein sutoon 2, 4, 1, 3. Backtracking nakam shaakh ko foran kaat deta hai, to har tarteeb aazmane se kahin kam configurations dekhta hai.

items: Backtracking: qadam ba qadam banao, band gali par wapas jao; N-Queens mashhoor misal hai.
